adapterVersions.source: pnpm-lock.yaml at a95d6b1a, the commit that added this file (#123). Reconstructed from git history on 2026-08-11, when comparator provenance was introduced. This run predates automatic version stamping, which is why the drift below survived three comparator bumps unremarked.

superseded.reason: ag-grid-community and ag-grid-react 33.3.2 -> 36.1.0, three majors (#162, #306); @mui/x-data-grid 7.29.13 -> 9.11.0, two majors, and @mui/material 5.18.0 -> 9.3.1 (#162, #150); @tanstack/react-virtual 3.13.24 -> 3.14.9, a minor; @tanstack/react-table is unchanged at 8.21.3
superseded.detail: Superseded, not wrong: the numbers stand for the versions named above and are kept so the measurement history stays readable. A re-measure is tracked separately and must run on a quiet machine, after the TanStack 9 decision (#277).

metricApplicability.reason: row_height_error_p95_px compares a row's rendered box against its tallest cell's content height, and cell.scrollHeight is floored at cell.clientHeight — so on a grid rendering white-space: nowrap no row height, however wrong, can move it. In this runset only pretable wrapped: the three comparator adapters read the scenario's `wrap` flag not at all and drew fixed 48px nowrap rows (#400, fixed by #415 on 2026-08-11, after this run). Their figures here are the constant offset between a row's border box and a cell's padding box — a box-model constant, not a layout error — and are marked not applicable rather than deleted, because the measurement happened and the record should say what it was.
metricApplicability.detail: pretable's own 1px stands: it was wrapping (rendered_rows_peak 11 against ag-grid's 27 in the same viewport, which is the row-count gap the asymmetry created), so its rows could have been wrong and were not. Nothing measured was changed by this annotation. A like-for-like re-measure is pending and needs a quiet machine.
